en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a multi‑storey historicist town building with ornate gables and dormer windows. On the ground floor is a wine tavern with the sign "Wein-Stuben ... Carl Lantzsch." In front of the house runs a cobbled street with an early electric tramcar. At the bottom in red script is a greeting mentioning Meissen and Lantzsch's wine tavern, and printer information runs vertically along the left edge.
